dig-sc-wait-1.title: South Carolina 811: when can work start after the locate request (3 full working days), SC811 holidays
dig-sc-wait-1.text: South Carolina: operators have three full working days to mark, not counting the day of the request, so with a Monday request work can start Friday when there is no holiday in between. SC811's 2026 holiday list adds days that do not count toward the three full working days even though the center is open: Confederate Memorial Day (May 11, 2026), Christmas Eve (December 24) and the day after Christmas (observed December 28, 2026); the notice is counted from the next business day. Its other 2026 holidays are New Year's Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Presidents' Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day (July 3), Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving and the day after, and Christmas. Columbus Day and Juneteenth are not on the list.

dig-ok-wait-1.text: Oklahoma: give notice at least 48 hours before digging, not counting the day of the notice, Saturdays, Sundays and legal holidays. So a notice given on a Monday can be dug Thursday when there is no holiday in between. Demolition needs 7 business days.
